# BioMIP Compare Scenarios


## CO2 Prices

```{r 01_summary/CO2 Prices}
showLinePlots(data, "Price|Carbon")
```

## GHG - different totals

### GHG total w/o Bunkers w/ national LULUCF accounting - should match UNFCCC
```{r 03_emissions/GHG total without Bunkers with national LULUCF accounting - should match UNFCCC}
showLinePlots(data, "Emi|GHG|w/o Bunkers|LULUCF national accounting")
```
### GHG total w/ Bunkers w/ national LULUCF accounting - should match UNFCCC
```{r 03_emissions/GHG total with Bunkers with national LULUCF accounting - should match UNFCCC}
showLinePlots(data, "Emi|GHG|w/ Bunkers|LULUCF national accounting")
```

### AFOLU total - should be scenario dependent for high/low ambition cases 
```{r 03_emissions/GHG total with Bunkers with national LULUCF accounting - should match UNFCCC}
showLinePlots(data, "Emi|GHG|AFOLU|LULUCF national accounting")
```


### GHG Emissions by Sector
```{r 01_summary/GHG emissions}
tot <- "Emi|GHG|LULUCF national accounting"
items <- c(
  "Emi|GHG|Energy",
  "Emi|GHG|Industrial Processes",
  "Emi|GHG|Land-Use Change|LULUCF national accounting",
  "Emi|GHG|Agriculture",
  "Emi|GHG|Waste",
  "Emi|GHG|non-ES CDR")
showAreaAndBarPlots(data, items, tot, scales = "fixed")
```

## CDR variables 

## CCS variables 

### Capture by CO2 origin - Bar
```{r 09_carbon_management/Capture by CO2 origin - Bar}
showAreaAndBarPlots(
  data = data,
  vars = rev(c('Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Biomass',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Fossil',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Synfuel',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Industrial Processes',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|DAC')),
  scales = 'fixed',
  orderVars = 'user')
```

### Carbon Capture from Industry Sector - Bar
```{r 09_carbon_management/Carbon Capture from Industry Sector - Bar}
showAreaAndBarPlots(
  data = data,
  vars = rev(c('Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Energy|Industry|Cement',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Industrial Processes|Cement',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Energy|Industry|Chemicals',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Energy|Industry|Steel')),
  scales = 'fixed',
  orderVars = 'user')
```

### Carbon Capture from CDR Sector - Bar
```{r 09_carbon_management/Carbon Capture from CDR Sector - Bar}
showAreaAndBarPlots(
  data = data,
  vars = rev(c('Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Energy|CDR Sector',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|Industrial Processes|CDR Sector|OAE',
               'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture|DAC')),
  scales = 'fixed',
  orderVars = 'user')
```

### Share of Storage in Capture - Line
```{r 09_carbon_management/Share of Storage in Capture}
showLinePlots(data, "Carbon Management|Share of Stored CO2 from Captured CO2")
```

### Use of captured carbon - Bar
```{r 09_carbon_management/Use of captured carbon - Bar}

                    tot = 'Carbon Management|Carbon Capture')
```
